title: Wait! I Have Vuln!
description:
For the moment your teammate swings first while you are holding Bash. This mod shows who holds a card that applies Vulnerable, so your team applies it before the big hits. It also shows a teammate's hand when you hover their card count.

[b]Only the players who want to see it need the mod. The host does not.[/b] It does not affect gameplay, so friends without the mod can still play with you, and it cannot desync a run.

[h2]What you see[/h2]
During a co-op combat:

[h3]Vulnerable icon[/h3]
During your team's turn, the Vulnerable icon appears next to a player's name in the top-left player list while they hold a supported card. It is bright while they can play the card, and dimmed while they cannot, for example without the energy. Your own row is included.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/a14d754bf72c48900a3bf351fc970c3e4b26ab95/docs/images/dimmed-icon.jpg[/img]

[h3]"Wait! I have vuln!"[/h3]
When a teammate's icon turns bright, for example when they draw Bash or gain the energy to play it, their character says so in a speech bubble for four seconds, while an enemy still needs Vulnerable. Your own character stays quiet, because you already know what is in your hand. It goes away once they can no longer play the card. The first bubble of each combat is always "Wait! I have vuln!"; later ones vary, and some call you by name.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/a14d754bf72c48900a3bf351fc970c3e4b26ab95/docs/images/icon-and-bubble.jpg[/img]

[h3]Card reminder[/h3]
Hover an Attack you can play while a teammate's icon is bright, and a thought cloud with the Vulnerable icon appears beside your card and moves with it.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/a14d754bf72c48900a3bf351fc970c3e4b26ab95/docs/images/card-cloud.jpg[/img]

[h3]Teammates' reactions[/h3]
Play the Attack anyway at an enemy that still needs Vulnerable, and that teammate reacts, angrier with each such Attack in the turn: "Nooo!", then "I HAD VULN!", then "I'm writing this down."
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/a14d754bf72c48900a3bf351fc970c3e4b26ab95/docs/images/reaction.jpg[/img]

[h3]Teammate's hand[/h3]
Hover the card count next to a teammate's name, and their hand appears as small cards to the right of the player list, in the order they hold them. It closes when the mouse leaves the card count, and it stays closed while you aim a card or a potion.

[b]Supported cards:[/b]
[list]
[*]Ironclad: Bash, Break, Dominate, Taunt, Thunderclap, Tremble, Uppercut
[*]Silent: Assassinate, Expose
[*]Defect: Beam Cell
[*]Necrobinder: Fear, High Five, Putrefy
[*]Regent: Comet, Falling Star, Gamma Blast, Know Thy Place, Meteor Shower
[*]Colorless and event cards: Shockwave, Squash, and Mad Science with the Sapping rider from the Tinker Time event
[/list]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
Want it quieter or bigger? On the main menu, before you start or continue a run, open Settings > Mod Settings and select Wait! I Have Vuln!. Use the mouse there; the keyboard cannot reach these settings. Your choices are kept for next time.
[list]
[*][b]Show icon on my own row:[/b] off hides everything on your own row.
[*][b]Icon size:[/b] 50% to 150%.
[*][b]Teammate hand preview:[/b] off turns the hand preview off.
[*][b]Show bubbles:[/b] off keeps only the icon, with no bubbles, cloud, or reactions.
[*][b]Card reminder:[/b] off turns the thought cloud off.
[*][b]Varied bubble lines:[/b] off keeps every bubble on one fixed line.
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/a14d754bf72c48900a3bf351fc970c3e4b26ab95/docs/images/settings.jpg[/img]

[h2]Good to know[/h2]
[list]
[*]Each player sees the icons and bubbles on their own screen only.
[*]A dimmed icon still matters: the player holds the card but cannot play it now, so a teammate's energy card or potion can still make it count.
[*]An enemy with Artifact does not count as needing Vulnerable, because the card would only remove an Artifact.
[*]A disconnected player's row shows no icon.
[*]The game's own bubbles come first: a "Wait! I have vuln!" waits while the game shows a bubble over that character.
[*]The bubble text is always English.
[*]The hand preview needs the mouse; it does not open while you play with a controller.
[*]Needs game version 0.107.1 or newer.
[*]Not tested yet: Mad Science with the Sapping rider, the hand preview's numbers after a teammate's Strength, Weak, or cost changes, using the settings with a controller, macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck.
[*]Single-player looks the same as without the mod. Solo mode [noparse][dev][/noparse] in the settings is a testing aid: it shows your own row in single-player from your next run, and turns off when the game restarts.
[/list]

[h2]Where did my saves go?[/h2]
With mods on, the game uses separate modded save profiles, so your unlocks look gone the first time. Your normal saves are untouched. To copy your normal progress into the modded profile, follow the [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/blob/main/docs/modded-saves.md]save guide[/url].

[h2]Found a bug?[/h2]
Leave a comment here or [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/issues]open an issue on GitHub[/url], and include the lines containing [noparse][WaitIHaveVuln][/noparse] from %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\logs\godot.log.
